skill.name: pre-client
skill.description: Analyze inbound emails to identify prospects, buying signals, relationship context, and follow-up priorities for sales teams.
skill.summary: Turns incoming email conversations into ranked pre-sales opportunities and recommended next actions.
skill.author: CleanExpo

security_audit.summary: Static command-execution and role-token findings are false positives caused by Markdown fenced examples and uppercase labels. The main real concern is privacy: the skill aggregates email content, contact data, metadata, and third-party enrichment sources.

remediation.issue: Personal data collection and enrichment lacks stated safeguards.
remediation.suggestion: Document consent requirements, allowed data sources, retention periods, access controls, and deletion procedures before analyzing real inbox data.

remediation.issue: External enrichment sources may process prospect data outside the user workspace.
remediation.suggestion: Require user approval before using LinkedIn, Crunchbase, search, CRM, or email APIs, and disclose what data is sent.

semantic_findings.title: Personal Data Aggregation Requires Privacy Controls
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs collection of sender identity, contact details, email metadata, LinkedIn URLs, attachments, and external enrichment data. This can expose personal and business-sensitive data if used without consent, retention limits, and access controls.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented capability explicitly collects contact information, message content, metadata, and enrichment from third-party sources. This is a clear privacy and data-governance risk, although it is not inherently malicious.

content.value_statement: Sales teams lose time sorting inbound emails and identifying serious prospects. This skill turns email context into lead profiles, buying signals, opportunity scores, and recommended follow-up actions.
actual_capabilities: Extracts sender details, company context, role, location, and contact clues from inbound emails.
Classifies buying signals by intent tier and recommends response urgency.
Groups related messages into conversation threads and summarizes engagement history.
Builds prospect relationship timelines with stage, activity, and next-step recommendations.
Scores opportunities using fit, intent, engagement, and timeline factors.
Describes enrichment workflows using sources such as LinkedIn, Crunchbase, search, CRM, and email metadata.
limitations: Version 1 scope does not provide live email API integration or automated CRM synchronization.
Opportunity scores are rule-based examples, not trained machine learning predictions.
External enrichment requires valid access, user approval, and compliance with each source policy.
The skill does not send automated replies or create email templates in its stated scope.

use_cases.title: Qualify new inbound leads
use_cases.description: Analyze a new email to identify the sender, company, intent, pain points, and response priority.

use_cases.title: Prepare account follow-up
use_cases.description: Summarize a multi-message thread into a timeline, buying committee view, and recommended next action.

use_cases.title: Rank weekly opportunities
use_cases.description: Review recent inbound messages and produce a prioritized list of high-value prospects to contact first.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze one inbound email
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for basic lead qualification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this inbound email. Extract the sender profile, company context, buying signals, pain points, and recommended response priority.

prompt_templates.title: Detect buying signals
prompt_templates.scenario: Classify urgency and sales intent from message content.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this email content for buying signals. Assign an intent tier, explain the evidence, and recommend the next sales action.

prompt_templates.title: Build a relationship timeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Summarize a prospect conversation across multiple messages.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a relationship timeline for this prospect thread. Include key events, participants, engagement level, current stage, and likely next step.

prompt_templates.title: Rank recent inbound opportunities
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for prioritizing a sales queue.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these recent inbound conversations. Score each opportunity by fit, intent, engagement, and timeline, then rank who to contact first.

output_examples.input: A prospect asks for pricing and says their current tool does not support their workflow.
output_examples.output: The output identifies a high-intent tool replacement opportunity, lists the pain point, estimates urgency, and recommends a fast personalized response.

output_examples.input: A five-day thread includes an initial inquiry, a follow-up, and a CTO joining the conversation.
output_examples.output: The output summarizes the timeline, notes buying committee expansion, raises the opportunity score, and recommends scheduling a discovery call.

output_examples.input: A weekly inbox review contains twelve possible sales conversations.
output_examples.output: The output groups leads into priority tiers, highlights the strongest opportunities, and gives suggested response timing for each tier.

best_practices: Use real business context, product fit criteria, and sales stage definitions when asking for opportunity scoring.
Review privacy obligations before using personal contact data, attachments, or external enrichment sources.
Treat scores as prioritization aids and confirm important account decisions with human review.
anti_patterns: Do not upload full inbox exports without confirming consent, retention rules, and access controls.
Do not treat inferred budget, authority, or timeline as verified facts without supporting evidence.
Do not automate outbound follow-up solely from the score without reviewing tone and context.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes inbound email content, sender context, thread history, buying signals, and opportunity priority.

faq.question: Does it connect directly to Gmail or Outlook?
faq.answer: The stated Version 1 scope describes analysis workflows, but not real-time email API integration.

faq.question: Can it enrich prospects with external sources?
faq.answer: It describes enrichment using LinkedIn, Crunchbase, search, CRM, and metadata, subject to access and compliance requirements.

faq.question: How are opportunities scored?
faq.answer: The skill uses fit, intent, engagement, and timeline factors to create a composite priority score.

faq.question: Is the scoring predictive machine learning?
faq.answer: No. The documented scope uses structured rules and examples, not trained predictive models.

faq.question: What should users verify before using it?
faq.answer: Users should verify privacy permissions, approved data sources, retention rules, and human review steps for sales actions.
